{{Sagittarius}}
Sagittarius 8 is the 8th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 8th day of Sagittarius, and it is a Monday. It corresponds to ISO week 2, weekday 1.

Its informal Japanese name is 1宮8日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 8|Chapter 8]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152028}}.

== Overview ==
**
** [[Sagittarius 8]] Coming of Age Day

* <br>

[[Category:Dates with custom text]]
===Chapter summary===
Rhodes, son of Ruby, and Marigold, of Chrystella’s line, form the first stellar union. Their love endures through cycles of novas, where Marigold’s fading light passes strength to Rhodes. Together they shine, grow old, and raise children of nebulae. Their legacy becomes enshrined in wedding vows, symbolized by ruby, topaz, and white opal rings—eternal emblems of their cosmic love.
